about: Party stands (self-combat wedge): the assist arms on ANY group member's combat flag (PartyCombatLatch), and the camp-assist seed then does SetInCombatWith on its target, so a follower becomes its own 'groupmate in combat' and re-arms the latch forever against a pack that never fights back (issue #18; 512 laps of 'assisting -> seeded -> silent tick' in the reporter's log). A 3-mob Halls of Lightning pack (snapshot tr-20260922-185337-10#23) is tagged and dragged; at aggroConfirmed one mob is turned onto a DPS (the combat blip), then the pack is evaded home and the tank's combat dropped, leaving a tagged-and-abandoned pack at home. The regroup mute half was fixed by 5bace3da; the seed's one-sided SetInCombatWith (DcFollowerActions.cpp) and the flag-only latch are unchanged. The blip lands on the healer: on dps2 (the affliction warlock) its DoTs kept the evaded Tactician in combat and the pack re-engaged 1.4s later, so no tagged-and-abandoned pack ever formed (lb-20261003-155828-1 run -54).

expect.knownFailure: open:#18 (memory dc-assist-selfcombat-wedge, fix-order item 2: seed SetInCombatWith without real threat)
